passages.inference: The actual raw relative third and both fourth matrix inequalities are pulled through the true whitening map by exact quadratic congruence. Whitening the actual covariance gives the actual support projection, whose quadratic form is<=normSq; this derives the exact signed-third and two fourth upper budgets needed by restoration. This is the equivalent physical-coordinate/pseudowhitening proof of the printed full-column-support P formulas, without any invertibility or positive-definiteness assumption onSigma. It avoids introducing a desired operator-norm budget as a hypothesis.
